round: Style Lab round 7: HyperFrames intro options (upgrades of the locked round-6 intro, STYLE.md rule 0)
rule: Workers use ONLY values in this file. Anything missing: stop and ask the supervisor. The locked production intro (scripts/style_fx.py intro, scripts/finish_fx.py) is NOT touched in this round.

reference.locked_build: style-lab/round6/build.py (r6-01 strobe, r6-03 burst + pulse); helpers in style-lab/round5/build.py

source.note: Same hook shot and song window as round 6 (r5/r6 load_frames: first 90 frames of multicam_version.mp4, scaled 1080x1920). Production (intro_card.json) used the same opening, 0-2.0 s; the Style Lab shows 3 s like round 6.
source.song: his song = the audio track of output/multicam_version.mp4, 0.0-3.0 s, level untouched (0 dB)
source.grade: none (ungraded footage, as every Style Lab round)

beats.cross_check: r7-00 runs `hf beats` on the 3 s song wav (his song, allowed); report its beats next to these. These cut_map values stay the law unless the supervisor changes them.

fonts.hyperframes_rule: Copy the .ttf into the option's own HF project (output/style_lab/r7/<id>/hf/assets/fonts/) and load it with @font-face from that local path. No CDN / Google / jsdelivr font, no Inter, no Geist (registry defaults must be replaced).

colours.gold_highlight_note: gold pushed 55 % toward white = the brightest the locked r6-03 pulse goes. Use only for a narrow moving sheen / pulse peak, never a full-title white, never on a beat as a flash.
colours.gold_split_note: the gold's own channels split apart (R only / G+B only) for the RGB glitch option; max alpha 0.6, only during a glitch window.
colours.subtitle: #FFFFFF

title_shadow.note: the locked tight letter shadow (round5 shadow_of), follows the letters, not a scrim

title.fit: LOCKED is 700 px wide (round5 TITLE_W = 700 -> Rubik Dirt 166 px)
title.reference_alpha: output/style_lab/r7/r7-00/ref/title_ref.png (PIL, round5 build_layers, exact locked placement). Every HF title at rest must match its alpha bbox within 6 px on each side.

shadow.applied_by: r7-00 composite.py, from the overlay alpha (the HF overlay itself has NO shadow)

title.max_scale_note: any slam / punch scale on the title group (around group_centre) must stay <= 1.30 so it never reaches the face box or the frame sides; the locked pulse peak is 1.06

subtitle.after: steady to frame 89, never flickers, identical in all five options

logo.colour: white; 85 % factor applied twice by round6/style_fx big_logo (alpha * 0.85, then pasted with itself as mask) = effective 72 % (max alpha 183/255). Production style_fx.py intro ships 72 %; Style Lab matches it (review 2026-11-21).
logo.placement: art cropped to its alpha bbox, fitted to 1000 px wide, centred in frame, whole logo inside the frame (round6 big_logo)
logo.layer: BEHIND him: base -> logo -> his cut-out -> title
logo.never: flicker-on, strobe, colour other than white, any part outside the frame

beat_behaviour.strobe: title invisible before frame 20; snaps on at frame 20; off for 2 frames on each later beat (frames 40-41, 60-61, 80-81); solid otherwise (r6-01)
beat_behaviour.burst_pulse: title invisible before frame 20; frames 20-27 follow the locked burst [0,1,0,0,1,1,0,1] (1 = visible); on each later beat b, frames b..b+5 brightness toward #ECD497 by 0.55*e and scale 1 + 0.06*e around group_centre, e = [1, 0.8, 0.55, 0.3, 0.12, 0] (r6-03)

face_and_safe_area.safe_note: Instagram covers the top 110 px and bottom 420 px; every drawn pixel (alpha > 20) of title, subtitle and VISIBLE logo stays inside
face_and_safe_area.face_box_source: round5 FACE (cap + face + beard over all of shot 1, +20 px margin; head dips f45-59, chin to y ~710)
face_and_safe_area.title_band_note: every title/subtitle pixel on frames 0-59 must be inside this band (below face_max_y 800 + 60 px); this also holds for scattered glyphs, glitch copies and the sweep
face_and_safe_area.shot2_note: frames 60-89 are the leg shot with no face; safe area still applies
face_and_safe_area.logo_on_face_note: round 6 measured 2087 px of logo on the soft mask edge near his face; options must not be worse than 2500

cutout.helpers: scripts/layered_title.py cut_session(), raw_masks(), smooth_masks() exactly as round5 person_masks()
cutout.per_shot: masks computed separately for frames 0-59 and 60-89 (never smoothed across the cut)
cutout.cost: ~9 s a frame on CPU -> about 14 min for 90 frames, once, in r7-00 only

sounds.mix: amix normalize=0, alimiter limit=0.8 (-1.9 dB), trimmed to 3.000 s (round5 encode())
sounds.shared_mix: output/style_lab/r7/r7-00/audio_mix.wav: every option uses this exact file, so Alfonso compares the picture only

hyperframes.render: hf render output/style_lab/r7/<id>/hf --format png-sequence --fps 30 --resolution portrait -o output/style_lab/r7/<id>/overlay
hyperframes.composition: 1080x1920, 30 fps, data-duration 3, transparent background, no media elements (no

rotation.note: Style Lab options do not read or write the rotation. Each option names its beat behaviour (strobe or burst_pulse) explicitly.
